entities.summary: Aydın is a city in and the seat of Aydın Province in Turkey's Aegean Region. The city is located at the heart of the lower valley of Büyük Menderes River at a commanding position for the region extending from the uplands of the valley down to the seacoast. The city forms the urban part of the Efeler district, with a population of 259,027 in 2022. Aydın city is located along a region which was famous for its fertility and productivity since ancient times. Figs remain the province's best-known crop, although other agricultural products are also grown intensively and the city has some light industry.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Aydın's fertile region has supported agriculture since ancient times, with figs being the province's best-known crop. This local agricultural significance has contributed to the city's growth and economic development.
